# bastiaan.dev

> Personal website and technical blog of Bastiaan Steinmeier, a self-taught full stack developer. Content covers web development (PHP/Laravel, TypeScript, Bun, React) and applied AI/LLM engineering (agentic orchestration, RAG, fine-tuning, semantic search).

Notes:

- The blog posts below are ordered newest first, matching the order on https://bastiaan.dev/blog.
- This site is built with Laravel, Livewire, and Tailwind CSS; the source code is public (see Optional section).

## Pages

- [Home](https://bastiaan.dev/): Introduction to Bastiaan Steinmeier and links to his socials (GitHub, LinkedIn, Discord).
- [Blog](https://bastiaan.dev/blog): Overview of all blog posts.
- [Contact](https://bastiaan.dev/contact): Contact form to reach Bastiaan directly.

## Blog posts

- [Building a parallel development squad: agentic orchestration with Claude](https://bastiaan.dev/blog/agentic-orchestration-claude): Replacing the monolithic chatbot with a squad of specialized sub-agents; building an autonomous development workflow with Claude, MCP, and local RAG.
- [End-to-End Type Safety: Building with the BEDR-stack](https://bastiaan.dev/blog/bedr-stack-monorepo-architecture): A practical, type-safe monorepo setup using Bun, Elysia, Drizzle, and React.
- [From Vectors to Answers: Building a Local RAG Agent](https://bastiaan.dev/blog/from-vectors-to-answers-local-rag): Building a local RAG agent with Bun, SQLite vector search, and Ollama.
- [Teaching a language model a skill (using poker as an example)](https://bastiaan.dev/blog/teaching-a-language-model-a-skill): Using fine-tuning to turn a hallucinating language model into a system you can actually trust.
- [Building a durable agent harness: workflow orchestration with Eve](https://bastiaan.dev/blog/durable-agent-harness-eve): Moving state management, subagent routing, and human approval gates out of a while loop and into a durable harness.
- [Modern Web Development with Bun, React, and Tailwind CSS](https://bastiaan.dev/blog/modern-web-development-with-bun): Introducing a streamlined stack of Bun, React, and Tailwind CSS for modern web development.
- [From Text to Vectors: A Practical Guide to Semantic Search](https://bastiaan.dev/blog/from-text-to-vectors): Building a semantic search engine using SQLite and OpenAI's API.
- [Hello, world](https://bastiaan.dev/blog/test-blog-post): The launch post introducing this personal website.
